record.intended_role: Floor stand carrying a wash bowl
record.description: Four wood legs, plank tabletop and apron carry a clay basin and blue-grey water surface.

mounting.align: Align placement_contact_px in chosen native view to the projected receiver contact; source pivot remains the art registration.
mounting.floor_contact: source origin floor plane; geometric mesh clearance is retained below
mounting.default_source_mount_height_status: measured source embedding, not a separate room-height choice
mounting.world_geometry_transform: worldPoint = receiverAnchor + T(sourcePoint - anchor_source_xyz), T recorded under units.source_model_conversion. Footprints/heights/solid_parts use source geometric origin; subtract anchor offset for placement.
mounting.sprite_alignment: screenPoint(u) = project(receiverAnchor) + pixelScale*(u - placement_contact_px); with preserved pivot p, sprite.position = project(receiverAnchor) + pixelScale*(p - placement_contact_px).

e.derivation: Source-model anchor projected with preserved camera; +64px x/y padding maps 256px static art to existing 384px catalog frame. Per-view contact is separate from source pivot.
e.confidence: medium: exact source rest projection, catalog padding evidenced by matching registrations; frame0 has documented pixel differences in some families

footprint.coordinate_origin: Preserved source geometric origin (0,0,0); mounting anchor has separate XYZ below. Rotate footprint with family orientation, never camera pose.
footprint.meaning: Convex enclosure of actual rest-mesh XY projection, for extent/placement fit only. Blocking uses component solids; this enclosure is not automatically a filled collision region.
footprint.provenance: measured preserved source meshes, converted by recorded camera registration

height.coordinate_origin: All heights below are relative to preserved source geometric origin, before placement; mounting includes its own source anchor height to subtract when attached elsewhere.
height.provenance: measured source rest-model bounds, render-equivalent registration conversion

blocking.coordinate_origin: Component XY polygons and Z intervals use the source geometric origin; apply the same mounting.world_geometry_transform to every component.
blocking.physical_solids: Individual wooden/iron/ceramic components at their actual heights; water is excluded.
blocking.floor_footprint_policy: continuous occupied solids, not a full-cell assignment

solid_parts.volume_interpretation: oriented source mesh; XY polygon and z interval bound its occupied solid, not a filled extrusion unless the component is an axis-aligned board/leg

blocking.status: authored physical interpretation using measured component bounds; runtime collision/navigation selection is separate
blocking.basin_interpretation: Thin ceramic/clay shell intended by basin role; original static Blender uses a capped cylindrical proxy. Exterior dimensions are measured, interior cavity/solid-shell thickness is an estimate and must not be inferred from water pixels.

solid_shell_estimate.confidence: low, new physical content estimate; no source mesh modification

preserved_metadata.animation_scope: Existing clocks, rows, pivots, source frames, candidate/destruction status and bindings remain owned by these existing records.

evidence.source_manifest_footprint_status: Existing packaging placeholders; concrete measured footprint supplied here.
evidence.geometry_confidence: high for preserved source mesh and source camera registration; this does not certify exact frame0-rest pixel equality.
evidence.semantic_confidence: medium, artwork/source naming support the authored role.

notes: Native generated camera labels map geometrically to engine quarters e=0,s=3,w=2,n=1 for the declared local-east XYZ conversion. Direct e/s/w/n to engine quarter0/1/2/3 swaps the two side views. Source rows and current selected bindings are preserved; consumers must use the measured crosswalk for these new profiles.

support_surfaces.geometry: top surfaces of existing tabletop planks; basin occupies central circular patch
